fields.acceptance: A new roadmap-umbrella.txtar with an umbrella intent, a milestone intent and change sets serving the umbrella, both, or nothing: roadmap --json shows group kinds milestone, backlog, umbrella in that order, an umbrella change set appears in no other group, and the human output heads the group with the intent's handle; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: A proposed or accepted change set serving an intent with a non-empty umbrella field is listed only in that intent's umbrella group, after the milestone groups and the backlog

fields.acceptance: In roadmap-umbrella.txtar ready --json gives that reason and its next is a non-umbrella change set; a case in internal/api's daemon tests shows an umbrella group with leaves yields no candidate
fields.statement: An umbrella change set is never ready, with the reason umbrella: work is carved out of it, so ready's next and the daemon skip it

fields.acceptance: A test in internal/tui/roadmapapp with a fake runner returning an umbrella group shows one row while collapsed and the change set rows after enter; --once output is unchanged
fields.statement: The roadmap app shows each umbrella group as one collapsed row naming how many change sets it holds, and enter expands or collapses it
